component.name: Nib-E
component.summary: The all-in-one PDF editor, every feature free

description.p: Nib-E reads, edits, signs and protects PDFs. Every feature is free: no paywalls, no Pro plan, no account. Your files stay on your computer and the app works without internet.

ul.li: Edit existing text in the PDF's own font, add text, images, links, header, footer and watermark
Fill forms, even ones without form fields, and sign by hand or with a certificate (.p12/.pfx)
Redact text and images for good, protect with a password (AES-256)
Merge, reorder, rotate and extract pages; two-page view
Study mode: write on the PDF with a pen, notebook beside it
Safe mode: scripts never run, links stay inert

description.p: Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazil) and Italian.

Edit existing text, certificate signing and signature checks, text recognition (OCR), print check, two-page view, more fonts, copy and paste, and five new languages. Linux: fixes a start-up crash on some graphics drivers.
